metadata.authorization: Generic public design prior authored without closed-submission data.
metadata.weight_policy: Authored design weights only: 4 primary, 3 common alternative, 2 meaningful secondary, 1 niche legitimate; not empirical usage.

sources.description: Public TUGS format, legal roster, Patch 1 and Patch 1.2 mechanics, and current gen9tugs server data.
Explicitly public generic archetype design judgment based only on public format facts and base-game mechanics.

metadata.rationale: Choice Band and maximum Attack apply immediate pressure while dual STAB coverage, Earthquake, and Fire Fang avoid relying on setup.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Choice Band reveal, choice locking, Dual Wingbeat, or Fire Fang narrows toward the immediate breaker.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary role with strong immediate damage but less flexibility than the lead.

metadata.rationale: Dragon Dance turns Aerodactyl's natural Speed into sweeping pressure while Life Orb boosts its broad coverage without move locking.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Dragon Dance, Life Orb, Unnerve, or the combined Rock, Ground, and Flying coverage identifies this setup line.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary win condition that requires a setup opportunity.

metadata.rationale: Focus Sash and maximum Speed support reliable Stealth Rock or Taunt while Earthquake and Stone Edge retain offensive pressure.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Focus Sash activation, Taunt, or Stealth Rock strongly narrows toward the dedicated lead.
metadata.weight_reason: Primary broadly applicable Aerodactyl role and the authoritative coverage baseline.

metadata.role: specially defensive trapping and removal utility
metadata.rationale: Heavy-Duty Boots preserve entry opportunities while Perish Song and Fire Spin create a specialized trapping line alongside Roost and Defog.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Perish Song, Fire Spin, Heavy-Duty Boots, or Defog without a physical attack narrows toward this trapping utility set.
metadata.weight_reason: Experimental specialized role whose trapping plan is matchup-dependent.

metadata.role: physically defensive removal and status utility
metadata.rationale: Heavy-Duty Boots, physical bulk, reliable recovery, and Will-O-Wisp support repeated removal while Brave Bird prevents complete passivity.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Brave Bird, Will-O-Wisp, Heavy-Duty Boots, or physically defensive behavior narrows toward this utility set.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary defensive role with removal, recovery, and status utility.

metadata.rationale: Choice Specs and maximum Special Attack and Speed create immediate pressure through four complementary special attacks.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Choice Specs, choice locking, Draco Meteor, Moonblast, or Hurricane narrows toward the special breaker.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary offensive role with immediate power but move-locking constraints.

metadata.role: fast offensive hazard setter using recoil-free Rock Head attacks
metadata.rationale: Rock Head enables Head Smash and Flare Blitz pressure while Heavy-Duty Boots and Stealth Rock combine offensive entry control with Extreme Speed.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Heavy-Duty Boots, Rock Head, Stealth Rock, or Head Smash narrows toward this offensive hazard set.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary role combining reliable recoil-free pressure with hazard utility.

metadata.rationale: Choice Band and Rock Head maximize immediate Head Smash and Flare Blitz pressure while Extreme Speed and Close Combat broaden finishing coverage.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Choice Band, choice locking, Close Combat, or unusually high physical damage narrows toward this wallbreaker.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary attacking role with strong immediate damage and priority.

metadata.role: offensive Intimidate utility with recovery and hazards
metadata.rationale: Intimidate, Morning Sun, and Heavy-Duty Boots support repeated defensive entries while Stealth Rock, Flare Blitz, and Extreme Speed retain pressure.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Intimidate, Morning Sun, Stealth Rock, or Heavy-Duty Boots narrows toward this utility set.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary role whose defensive value depends on effective Intimidate cycling.

metadata.rationale: Soundproof and Leftovers support repeated entry; hazards, poison, Defense-based damage, and Parting Shot compress support roles.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Soundproof immunity, Leftovers recovery, or any of Stealth Rock, Toxic, and Parting Shot separates it from the setup and Sturdy lines.
metadata.weight_reason: Primary broadly useful Bastiodon support role.

metadata.rationale: ChestoRest gives one reliable reset while Iron Defense powers Body Press; Rock Blast prevents total passivity into Ghost targets.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Iron Defense or Chesto Berry is decisive evidence; Rest and Rock Blast further distinguish the set.
metadata.weight_reason: Meaningful secondary win-condition role with narrower matchups.

metadata.rationale: Minimum Speed supports Metal Burst; Sturdy guarantees a full-HP survival and Custap enables emergency hazards, damage, or pivoting afterward.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Sturdy, Custap Berry, Metal Burst, or minimum-Speed ordering identifies this niche line.
metadata.weight_reason: Niche but coherent emergency line, kept at the lowest prior.

metadata.rationale: Heavy-Duty Boots and maximum Speed support repeated U-turn and Knock Off utility, with Stealth Rock and Memento providing lead value.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Heavy-Duty Boots, Stealth Rock, Memento, or Big Pecks narrows toward this utility set.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary utility role with hazards, item disruption, pivoting, and sacrifice value.

metadata.role: Choice Scarf revenge killer and pivot
metadata.rationale: Choice Scarf supplies revenge-killing speed while Rocky Payload strengthens Stone Edge and U-turn preserves momentum.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Rocky Payload, Choice Scarf, choice locking, Stone Edge, or unexpected speed narrows toward this revenge killer.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary speed-control role with useful pivoting but choice-locking constraints.

metadata.rationale: Choice Band adds immediate physical pressure while Sucker Punch supplies priority and U-turn and Knock Off maintain utility.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Choice Band, choice locking, Sucker Punch, or Big Pecks narrows toward this breaker.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary breaking role with priority and momentum but move-locking constraints.

metadata.rationale: Maximum physical bulk, Rocky Helmet, and Synthesis support repeated contact punishment while Spikes, Body Press, and Knock Off generate progress.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Rocky Helmet, Spikes, Synthesis, or Body Press narrows toward this physical wall.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary defensive role with hazards, recovery, and contact punishment.

metadata.rationale: Leftovers, Spiky Shield, and Drain Punch sustain Chesnaught while Toxic and Knock Off disrupt defensive answers.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Leftovers, Spiky Shield, Toxic, or Drain Punch narrows toward this disruption set.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary defensive role that trades hazards for broader disruption and passive recovery.

metadata.role: specially defensive Regenerator hazard, removal, and pivot utility
metadata.rationale: Regenerator and Boots sustain repeated entry while hazards, removal, delayed pressure, and Teleport compress support roles.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Regenerator, Stealth Rock, Rapid Spin, Teleport, or Future Sight supports this rocks utility line.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary role with recovery, hazards, removal, and pivoting.

metadata.role: slow Regenerator Trick Room and pivot support
metadata.rationale: A Speed-lowering nature supports slow Teleport under Trick Room while Regenerator, Toxic, and Future Sight provide durable support.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Regenerator, Trick Room, Toxic, Teleport, Sassy nature, or low-Speed behavior identifies this mode setter.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary support role whose value depends on Trick Room partners.

metadata.role: specially defensive Levitate hazard, removal, and pivot utility
metadata.rationale: Levitate supplies a Ground immunity while the shared rocks, removal, delayed pressure, and pivot structure retains broad utility.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Levitate is decisive; Stealth Rock, Rapid Spin, Teleport, and Future Sight remain compatible with both rocks variants.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible alternative defensive axis distinguished primarily by ability.

metadata.role: specially defensive status and hazard utility
metadata.rationale: Special bulk and Leftovers support repeated entries while Will-O-Wisp and Scald enable Hex and Stealth Rock adds persistent utility.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Perish Body, Leftovers, Will-O-Wisp, Hex, or Stealth Rock narrows toward this utility set.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary utility role with status synergy, hazards, and special bulk.

metadata.role: bulky immediate special wallbreaker retaining Perish Body
metadata.rationale: Choice Specs and maximum Special Attack provide immediate coverage pressure while HP investment and Perish Body retain defensive interaction value.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Perish Body, Choice Specs, choice locking, Ice Beam, or Earth Power narrows toward this bulky breaker.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary breaker with immediate power and bulk but limited Speed.

metadata.role: offensive Weak Armor wallbreaker capable of gaining Speed after a physical hit
metadata.rationale: Choice Specs supplies immediate power while maximum Speed and Weak Armor can turn a physical hit into a faster offensive position.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Weak Armor, Choice Specs, maximum-Speed behavior, choice locking, Ice Beam, or Earth Power narrows toward this offensive breaker.
metadata.weight_reason: Experimental matchup-dependent role that relies on surviving and exploiting a physical hit.

metadata.rationale: Heavy-Duty Boots protect entry opportunities while Swords Dance and Steelworker-backed Anchor Shot create strong setup pressure alongside Power Whip and Knock Off.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Heavy-Duty Boots, Swords Dance, Knock Off, or Anchor Shot narrows toward this setup breaker.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary role combining entry resilience, setup pressure, and item disruption.

metadata.rationale: Choice Band and Steelworker provide immediate physical pressure through dual STAB attacks, Poltergeist, and Knock Off.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Choice Band, choice locking, Poltergeist, or unusually high damage narrows toward this wallbreaker.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary breaker with high immediate damage but move-locking constraints.

metadata.rationale: Heavy-Duty Boots preserve entry opportunities while Swords Dance boosts three complementary physical attacks at maximum Speed.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Swords Dance, Poison Jab, or Heavy-Duty Boots narrows toward this setup attacker.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary offensive role with flexible coverage and setup pressure.

metadata.rationale: Maximum Speed enables quick Toxic Spikes and Taunt while Earthquake and Knock Off prevent passive hazard play.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Toxic Spikes, Taunt, or Heavy-Duty Boots narrows toward this utility set.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary role with valuable hazard pressure that depends on matchup and removal dynamics.

metadata.role: physical contact punishment, hazards, paralysis, and phazing
metadata.rationale: Rough Skin and Rocky Helmet punish contact while Crag Mend sustains hazards, Glare, and Dragon Tail utility.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Rough Skin, Rocky Helmet, Crag Mend, Glare, or Stealth Rock identifies this physical utility wall.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary role using Druddigon's recovery and contact punishment.

metadata.rationale: Choice Band and maximum Attack produce immediate damage while Sucker Punch offsets low Speed and coverage pressures varied targets.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Choice Band, choice locking, Sucker Punch, Superpower, or Gunk Shot identifies this wallbreaker.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary breaker with immediate power but move-locking constraints.

metadata.role: specially defensive Mold Breaker utility and phazing
metadata.rationale: Special bulk and Crag Mend support hazards and phazing while Mold Breaker lets Earthquake ignore relevant abilities.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Mold Breaker, Rocky Helmet, Earthquake, Crag Mend, or Dragon Tail supports this utility wall.
metadata.weight_reason: Experimental defensive axis whose Mold Breaker value is matchup-dependent.

metadata.rationale: Heavy-Duty Boots and physical bulk support repeated Calm Mind and Roost opportunities while Boomburst and Shadow Ball provide broad special coverage.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Thick Fat, Calm Mind, Shadow Ball, or Heavy-Duty Boots narrows toward this special setup set.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary setup role with recovery, physical bulk, and strong neutral coverage.

metadata.role: specially offensive paralysis and hazard utility
metadata.rationale: Chople Berry and the tailored Speed spread support a specialized Glare and Stealth Rock line while paralysis powers Hex and Boomburst retains immediate damage.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Thick Fat, Chople Berry, Glare, Hex, or Stealth Rock narrows toward this utility set.
metadata.weight_reason: Experimental specialized role with a tailored spread and several competing utility goals.

metadata.role: specially defensive physical setup and paralysis pressure
metadata.rationale: Special bulk, Leftovers, and Roost support Coil setup while Serene Grace Body Slam spreads paralysis and Dragon Tail disrupts opposing setup.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Serene Grace, Coil, Body Slam, Dragon Tail, or Leftovers narrows toward this physical setup set.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary setup role with useful paralysis pressure but gradual damage output.

metadata.rationale: Heavy-Duty Boots and physical bulk support repeated Calm Mind and Roost opportunities while Boomburst and Shadow Ball provide broad special coverage.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Thick Fat, Calm Mind, Shadow Ball, or Heavy-Duty Boots narrows toward this exact-form special setup set.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary setup role with recovery, physical bulk, and strong neutral coverage.

metadata.role: specially offensive paralysis and hazard utility
metadata.rationale: Chople Berry and the tailored Speed spread support a specialized Glare and Stealth Rock line while paralysis powers Hex and Boomburst retains immediate damage.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Thick Fat, Chople Berry, Glare, Hex, or Stealth Rock narrows toward this exact-form utility set.
metadata.weight_reason: Experimental specialized role with a tailored spread and several competing utility goals.

metadata.role: specially defensive physical setup and paralysis pressure
metadata.rationale: Special bulk, Leftovers, and Roost support Coil setup while Serene Grace Body Slam spreads paralysis and Dragon Tail disrupts opposing setup.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Serene Grace, Coil, Body Slam, Dragon Tail, or Leftovers narrows toward this exact-form physical setup set.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary setup role with useful paralysis pressure but gradual damage output.

metadata.rationale: Focus Sash creates a setup opportunity for Swords Dance while Sucker Punch adds priority to Earthquake and Iron Head coverage.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Focus Sash activation, Swords Dance, or Sucker Punch narrows toward this setup attacker.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary setup role whose reliability depends on preserving Focus Sash.

metadata.rationale: Focus Sash and maximum Speed support reliable Stealth Rock while Memento converts the lead into setup momentum after Earthquake and Iron Head pressure.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Focus Sash activation, Stealth Rock, or Memento narrows toward this dedicated lead.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary lead role with hazards and a clear sacrifice plan.

metadata.rationale: Choice Scarf supplies revenge-killing Speed while Pursuit threatens withdrawing targets and Earthquake, Iron Head, and Stone Edge provide coverage.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Choice Scarf, choice locking, Pursuit, or unexpected Speed narrows toward this revenge killer.
metadata.weight_reason: Experimental specialized speed-control role whose Pursuit value is matchup-dependent.

metadata.rationale: Choice Band provides immediate physical pressure while Sucker Punch supplies priority and the remaining attacks offer broad coverage.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Choice Band, choice locking, Sucker Punch, or unusually high damage narrows toward this wallbreaker.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary breaker with priority and immediate damage but move-locking constraints.

metadata.role: specially defensive item-removal and Defog utility
metadata.rationale: Black Sludge and Roost sustain a specially defensive pivot while Corrosive Gas removes items and Defog clears hazards.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Black Sludge, Corrosive Gas, Defog, U-turn, or Roost identifies this item-removal utility line.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary utility role using Dustox's custom move access.

metadata.role: specially defensive Boots removal and pivot utility
metadata.rationale: Boots ensure entry resilience while Sludge Bomb provides direct pressure and U-turn preserves momentum after removal.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Heavy-Duty Boots, Sludge Bomb, Defog, U-turn, or Roost identifies this pivoting removal line.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary utility role with safer entry and direct damage.

metadata.rationale: Maximum physical investment drives its contact coverage while Flamethrower preserves mixed pressure and slow Volt Switch supplies momentum.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Assault Vest, four attacks, Close Combat, Flamethrower, or slow Volt Switch identifies this mixed pivot.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary role combining bulk, coverage, and momentum.

metadata.rationale: Substitute creates protected turns for Power-Up Punch while Knock Off and Supercell Slam provide disruptive physical pressure.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Leftovers, Substitute, Power-Up Punch, or Supercell Slam identifies this setup line.
metadata.weight_reason: Experimental setup role that depends on creating safe Substitute turns.

metadata.rationale: Special bulk and entry resilience support item removal, status, phazing, and slow momentum in one utility package.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Heavy-Duty Boots, Toxic, Dragon Tail, Knock Off, or Volt Switch narrows toward this utility pivot.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary role with broad utility but limited direct recovery.

metadata.rationale: Choice Scarf builds on Flygon's Speed while Earthquake and Outrage pressure targets and U-turn preserves momentum.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Choice Scarf, choice locking, Outrage, unexpected Speed, or U-turn supports this revenge killer.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary speed-control role with useful pivoting.

metadata.rationale: Choice Band supplies immediate power while First Impression adds priority and Scale Shot can punish slower openings.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Choice Band, choice locking, First Impression, Scale Shot, or unusually high physical damage identifies this breaker.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary breaking role with prediction and move-locking costs.

metadata.role: physical setup attacker resistant to stat reduction
metadata.rationale: Clear Amulet protects setup progress while Dragon Dance and Scale Shot create multiple routes to increased Speed.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Clear Amulet, Dragon Dance, Throat Chop, or Scale Shot narrows toward this setup attacker.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary win condition that requires a setup opportunity.

metadata.role: Loaded Dice Scale Shot utility attacker
metadata.rationale: Loaded Dice stabilizes Scale Shot while Stealth Rock and U-turn let Flygon provide utility before attacking.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Loaded Dice is decisive; Stealth Rock, Scale Shot, and U-turn remain supporting evidence.
metadata.weight_reason: Experimental hybrid role balancing item-dependent offense with hazards.

metadata.rationale: Life Orb and mixed investment let Earthquake, Draco Meteor, and Fire Blast pressure different defenses while retaining Stealth Rock.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Life Orb, Draco Meteor, Fire Blast, Stealth Rock, or mixed damage identifies this attacker.
metadata.weight_reason: Experimental mixed role whose split investment limits peak damage on either side.

metadata.role: physical wall, hazard setter, spinner, and contact punishment
metadata.rationale: Maximum Defense powers Body Press while Rocky Helmet punishes contact and the remaining moves compress hazards, removal, and momentum.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Overcoat, Rocky Helmet, Body Press, Stealth Rock, or Rapid Spin identifies this physical wall.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary role combining physical bulk and role compression.

metadata.rationale: Boots help preserve Sturdy while dual hazards, Volt Switch, and Rapid Spin provide dedicated team support.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Sturdy, Heavy-Duty Boots, Spikes, Stealth Rock, or Rapid Spin identifies this dual-hazard line.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary support role with strong hazard compression but no direct recovery.

metadata.role: fast Focus Sash hazard and disruption lead
metadata.rationale: Focus Sash supports guaranteed disruption while Spikes, Taunt, Destiny Bond, and Icy Wind pressure opposing leads.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Focus Sash activation, Spikes, Taunt, Destiny Bond, or Icy Wind identifies this lead.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary lead role with several forms of disruption.

metadata.rationale: Physical investment and Boots improve repeated entry while Will-O-Wisp empowers Hex and Pain Split supplies conditional recovery.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Heavy-Duty Boots, Will-O-Wisp, Pain Split, Hex, or Spikes supports this bulky utility line.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary utility role whose recovery depends on matchup state.

metadata.rationale: Choice Specs amplifies dual STAB and Thunderbolt coverage while Trick can exchange the locking item with a defensive target.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Choice Specs, choice locking, Trick, Thunderbolt, or high special damage identifies this attacker.
metadata.weight_reason: Experimental immediate-damage role that gives up hazard utility.

metadata.role: Guts physical wallbreaker with Speed boosting
metadata.rationale: Flame Orb reliably activates Guts, Facade converts status into power, and Trailblaze can improve sweeping Speed.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Flame Orb, Guts, Facade, or Trailblaze identifies this wallbreaker.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary breaking role with clear item and ability synergy.

metadata.role: Choice Scarf revenge killer and potential cleaner
metadata.rationale: Choice Scarf supplies revenge-killing Speed and Moxie can turn a knockout into continued cleaning pressure.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Choice Scarf, Moxie, choice locking, Megahorn, or unexpected Speed identifies this cleaner.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary speed-control role with move-locking constraints.

metadata.rationale: Bulk Up creates a setup route while Leftovers offsets chip and three physical attacks provide broad neutral pressure.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Leftovers, Bulk Up, Guts, or Earthquake narrows toward this setup attacker.
metadata.weight_reason: Meaningful but matchup-dependent setup role without immediate Guts activation.

metadata.role: bulky Assault Vest spinner with Intimidate
metadata.rationale: Assault Vest and Intimidate provide mixed defensive utility while four attacks preserve removal, priority, and coverage.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Assault Vest, Intimidate, four attacks, Mach Punch, or Triple Axel supports this bulky spinner.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary role combining bulk, removal, and priority.

metadata.rationale: Maximum Speed and Boots distinguish a faster removal line while preserving Intimidate and the same offensive move structure.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Heavy-Duty Boots, Intimidate, offensive Speed behavior, Mach Punch, or Triple Axel supports this spinner.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary offensive-removal role with less bulk than the primary line.

metadata.rationale: Technician strengthens Bullet Punch and Triple Axel while bulk and Boots support repeated removal attempts.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Technician, Bullet Punch, Heavy-Duty Boots, or Triple Axel identifies this offensive utility line.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary role with distinctive ability and priority evidence.

metadata.rationale: Special bulk supports repeated utility while Toxic adds progress and Technician improves the low-power attacks.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Technician, Toxic, Mach Punch, Heavy-Duty Boots, or special bulk identifies this utility line.
metadata.weight_reason: Experimental specialized wall that trades immediate power for special bulk.

metadata.rationale: Life Orb boosts a Nasty Plot sweep while Hidden Power Grass broadens coverage beyond Dark and Fire targets.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Life Orb, Nasty Plot, Hidden Power Grass, or Flamethrower supports this wallbreaker.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary setup role with flexible coverage.

metadata.rationale: Choice Scarf supplies speed control, Overheat offers peak damage, Flamethrower preserves a stable Fire option, and Sludge Bomb adds coverage.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Choice Scarf, choice locking, Overheat, Sludge Bomb, or unexpected Speed identifies this revenge killer.
metadata.weight_reason: Experimental specialized speed-control role with deliberate overlapping Fire attacks.

metadata.rationale: Boots protect repeated entry while Substitute can create a safer Nasty Plot opportunity and Fire Blast supplies high damage.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Heavy-Duty Boots, Nasty Plot, Substitute, or Fire Blast supports this setup attacker.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary setup role with entry resilience and protection.

metadata.role: physically defensive Boots spinblocker and disruption utility
metadata.rationale: Boots support repeated entry while Strength Sap sustains physical defense and Taunt disrupts passive targets.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Heavy-Duty Boots, Water Absorb, Strength Sap, Taunt, or Shadow Ball supports this physical wall.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary physical wall with entry resilience and disruption.

metadata.role: physically defensive spinblocker using Colbur Berry for Dark attacks
metadata.rationale: Colbur Berry provides one-time Dark resistance while the same Strength Sap and Taunt structure preserves physical utility.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Colbur Berry, Water Absorb, Strength Sap, Taunt, or Shadow Ball supports this physical wall.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible alternative distinguished chiefly by one-time Dark protection.

metadata.role: specially defensive Water Absorb status utility
metadata.rationale: Water Absorb and special bulk create defensive entries while Will-O-Wisp powers Hex and Recover supplies reliable longevity.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Water Absorb, Leftovers, Hex, Will-O-Wisp, or Recover supports this special wall.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary special wall with recovery and status synergy.

metadata.role: specially defensive Cursed Body status utility
metadata.rationale: Cursed Body provides a distinct disruption axis while the shared special bulk, status, Hex, and Recover structure remains durable.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Cursed Body, Leftovers, Hex, Will-O-Wisp, or Recover supports this special wall.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible defensive alternative distinguished primarily by ability.

metadata.rationale: Maximum Special Attack and Choice Specs provide immediate power while Trick can exchange the locking item with a defensive target.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Choice Specs, choice locking, Trick, Ice Beam, or Hydro Pump identifies this wallbreaker.
metadata.weight_reason: Experimental proactive role that trades recovery for immediate damage.

metadata.role: fast Choice Specs wallbreaker with Trick
metadata.rationale: Choice Specs creates immediate dual-STAB pressure while Shadow Ball broadens coverage and Trick can disable defensive answers.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Choice Specs, Trick, Shadow Ball, or choice locking identifies this line among Dry Skin variants.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary immediate wallbreaking role.

metadata.role: Focus Sash Nasty Plot attacker with Unburden potential
metadata.rationale: Focus Sash protects Nasty Plot and can activate Unburden while dual STAB and Energy Ball provide broad coverage.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Focus Sash, Energy Ball, Nasty Plot, or consumed-item Unburden behavior identifies this set.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary setup role with conditional Unburden activation.

metadata.role: Throat Spray special attacker with Unburden activation
metadata.rationale: Hyper Voice consumes Throat Spray to boost Special Attack and activate Unburden before broad special coverage.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Throat Spray, Hyper Voice, or their item-consumption and Unburden sequence identifies this set.
metadata.weight_reason: Experimental activation-dependent role pending live testing.

metadata.role: fast Boots attacker and Encore utility
metadata.rationale: Heavy-Duty Boots preserve entry health while Encore and three attacks provide flexible disruption and coverage.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Heavy-Duty Boots or Encore identifies this line; Dry Skin alone overlaps Choice Specs.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary flexible attacker with useful disruption.

metadata.role: fast Focus Sash hazard lead and pivot
metadata.rationale: Focus Sash secures lead utility while maximum Speed supports Stealth Rock, Flip Turn, and immediate physical disruption.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Focus Sash, Stealth Rock, Flip Turn, or Knock Off supports the lead; Knock Off alone overlaps the Sash setup line.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary lead combining hazards, pivoting, and offensive pressure.

metadata.role: fast hazard setter, remover, and pivot
metadata.rationale: Heavy-Duty Boots preserve repeated entries while Rapid Spin, Stealth Rock, and Flip Turn compress field control and momentum.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Heavy-Duty Boots or Rapid Spin is decisive; Stealth Rock plus Flip Turn is also characteristic.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary utility role that trades Focus Sash insurance for repeatable entry.

metadata.rationale: Focus Sash can guarantee a setup opportunity while Swords Dance powers physical STAB and Knock Off coverage.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Swords Dance or Liquidation identifies the setup line; Focus Sash and Knock Off overlap the lead.
metadata.weight_reason: Experimental matchup-dependent setup role competing with Kabutops utility sets.

metadata.rationale: Choice Band and maximum Attack create immediate pressure while Scrappy and broad coverage reduce safe switch-ins.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Choice Band, choice locking, Hammer Arm, Double-Edge, or unusually high physical damage identifies the breaker.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary attacking role with immediate power.

metadata.role: fast Boots attacker with dual priority
metadata.rationale: Heavy-Duty Boots preserve entry health while Fake Out and Sucker Punch add flexible priority to Scrappy offense.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Heavy-Duty Boots, Fake Out, Sucker Punch, or Scrappy with Boots supports this attacker.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary role trading immediate Choice Band power for flexibility and durability.

metadata.role: specially defensive trapping and Rest utility
metadata.rationale: Early Bird shortens Rest while Whirlpool, Seismic Toss, and Toxic create a specialized trapping and attrition plan.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Early Bird, Whirlpool, Seismic Toss, Rest, or Toxic separates this line from physical attackers.
metadata.weight_reason: Experimental specialized role whose trapping plan is matchup-dependent.

metadata.role: bulky Substitute and Power-Up Punch attacker
metadata.rationale: Balanced bulk and Leftovers support Substitute while Toxic and Power-Up Punch create incremental pressure before Return.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Substitute, Power-Up Punch, Return, or Leftovers identifies this bulky setup structure.
metadata.weight_reason: Experimental specialized setup role requiring sustained field position.

metadata.role: bulky Ancient Shell pivot and cleric
metadata.rationale: Ancient Shell and Boots support repeated entry while maximum Special Attack, Chilly Reception, and Heal Bell combine pressure, pivoting, and cleric utility.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Chilly Reception or Heal Bell identifies this role; Ancient Shell alone overlaps four variants.
metadata.weight_reason: Broadly reliable primary role using Lapras public additions directly.

metadata.rationale: Loaded Dice strengthens Icicle Spear while Dragon Dance and maximum physical investment create a distinct setup route.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Loaded Dice, Dragon Dance, or Icicle Spear identifies this physical variant.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary setup role requiring a setup opportunity.

metadata.rationale: Physical bulk, modest Speed, Water Absorb, and four special attacks create a durable offensive alternative to Ancient Shell sets.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Water Absorb or Alluring Voice identifies this line; Hydro Pump supports its offensive profile.
metadata.weight_reason: Credible secondary offensive tank with a distinct defensive ability.

metadata.role: Ancient Shell Choice Specs special wallbreaker
metadata.rationale: Choice Specs and maximum Special Attack create immediate pressure while Hidden Power Fire covers specific resistant targets.
metadata.distinguishing_evidence: Choice Specs, choice locking, Hidden Power Fire, or Hydro Pump identifies this wallbreaker.
